result.reason: The added Licensor indemnity substantially tracks the preferred vendor-side coverage and includes basic claim procedures. However, the operative language leaves Licensee's existing indemnity unchanged and therefore does not limit it to Licensee-provided content and breach of law. In addition, Licensor's indemnity appears subject to the existing cap of one-half of amounts paid, rather than the fallback 3× annual-fees super-cap. The new paragraph is also incorrectly numbered and placed as subsection (iv) after Article XIII rather than within Article XII. The margin comment does not cure these operative defects.
